card.name: Defining a broad umbrella term
card.fires_on: Words right after a disease or category name where the text is about to call it a general or umbrella term, such as 'is a' or 'is' in 'Liver disease is a general term'. Also 'grouped under' and 'catch-all'.

modes.label: Definition opener
modes.description: The 'is' or 'a' after a disease name in a definition that begins a broad category description.

modes.description: Words in phrases saying things are grouped under one label or umbrella.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'collectively', 'collective', 'umbrella', 'generic' and 'encompass', which signal a broad category.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say that a name is a broad catch-all term covering many things.
